answer: Creating N sybils costs N staked pearls plus N lotus computations, while honest agents recover stakes at dawn. Each agent must stake a pearl token locked until dawn, and every epoch it solves a unique lotus proof-of-work tied to its identity. Attackers thus burn real capital and compute per fake identity, making large-scale sock-puppet farming economically irrational. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
